title: Johnson County Various Adult Residential Center (ARC) Campus ADA Modifications Project

onscreen_lines.desc: BASE BID #1 (LUMP SUM): Provide all labor, materials, equipment, and services necessary to complete the Johnson County Various ARC Campus ADA Modifications Project in accordance with the Finkle + Williams Drawings titled "ARCP ADA Compliance - 2026" dated September 15, 2026, and Project Manual dated September 24, 2026.

ADA PLAN GENERAL NOTES:
NOT ALL RESTROOMS WITHIN THE ARCP REQUIRED TO BE ACCESSIBLE, RESTROOMS HIGHLIGHTED
WITH YELLOW ON THE PLANS HAVE BEEN MODIFIED TO COMPLY WITH ADA 2010, AND 2009 ICC A117.1.
PLAN SHOWS ACCESSIBLE ROUTES HIGHLIGHTED AND CLEAR FLOOR SPACE ALONG EACH PATH.
1.REFER TO A0.04 - ADA DETAILS, FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION REGARDING REQUIRED MOUNTING
HEIGHTS, REQUIRED ACCESSORIES.
2.REFER TO A1.10 - FLOOR PLAN FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.
3.REFER TO A4.## SERIES OF DRAWINGS FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION REGARDING THE EXTENT
OF DEMOLITION AND MODIFICATION TO EXISTING TOILETS.

RESTROOMS; 2009 ICC A117.1 SECTION 604.5.1 DOES REQUIRE A VERTICAL GRAB BAR.

MARSHAL.
6.REFERENCE ELECTRICAL DRAWINGS FOR EXIT SIGNAGE, EMERGENCY LIGHTING AND EGRESS
LIGHTING.
